name: mule-flow-canvas
description: Renders Mule integration flow XML as an interactive canvas inline in Claude Desktop.
long_description:
Companion to the build-headless-integration skill. Exposes a `render_mule_flow` tool that reads a generated Mule project's `src/main/mule/<name>.xml`, parses it into a node/edge graph, and returns a UI resource Claude Desktop iframes inline. The canvas is read-only — flow edits go through the chat (the agent regenerates the project).

v1 limitations: containers like `<choice>`, `<try>`, `<scatter-gather>`, and `<foreach>` collapse to a single summary node. For full nested layout, open the project in Anypoint Code Builder.
